scripts.dist: DIST="$HOME/Desktop/行者的星球-网页发布包" && rm -rf "$DIST" "${DIST}.zip" && mkdir -p "$DIST/assets" && cp index.html styles.css sw.js "$DIST/" && cp -R js "$DIST/js" && cp -R vendor "$DIST/vendor" && cp -R assets/postcards "$DIST/assets/postcards" && ([ -f assets/og-cover.jpg ] && cp assets/og-cover.jpg "$DIST/assets/" || true) && (cd "$HOME/Desktop" && zip -rq "行者的星球-网页发布包.zip" "行者的星球-网页发布包") && echo "Published clean bundle to $DIST"
